# hitachi_vsp_snapshot_family (Data Source)

Datasource to show the snapshot family (parents and cascaded clones) for a specific LDEV in Hitachi VSP storage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
#
# Hitachi VSP Snapshot Family Data Retrieval
#
# This data source retrieves the snapshot lineage (Family Table) for a specific 
# Logical Device (LDEV). It provides a list of all related volumes, including 
# P-VOLs, S-VOLs, and Virtual Clones (vClones).
#
# The "Family" represents the relationship hierarchy of a volume, which is 
# especially critical for tracking members after a Snapshot Group promotion (vClone) 
# where traditional group metadata is replaced by standalone LDEV attributes.
#

#####################
data "hitachi_vsp_snapshot_family" "vclonefamily" {
  serial  = var.serial_number
  ldev_id = 681
  # or
  # ldev_id_hex = "0x557"
}

output "vclone_family" {
  value = data.hitachi_vsp_snapshot_family.vclonefamily.family_members
}

output "vclone_family_count" {
  value = data.hitachi_vsp_snapshot_family.vclonefamily.total_members
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `serial` (Number) Serial number of the storage system.

### Optional

- `ldev_id` (Number) The LDEV ID of the volume to query the snapshot family for. Only one of ldev_id or ldev_id_hex may be specified, not both.
- `ldev_id_hex` (String) The LDEV ID in hex of the volume to query the snapshot family for. Only one of ldev_id or ldev_id_hex may be specified, not both.

### Read-Only

- `family_members` (Block List) List of volumes belonging to the snapshot family, including parents and virtual clones. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--family_members))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `total_members` (Number) The total number of volumes found in this snapshot family.

<a id="nestedblock--family_members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `family_members`

Read-Only:

- `is_virtual_clone_parent_volume` (Boolean) True if the volume is a parent of a virtual clone.
- `is_virtual_clone_volume` (Boolean) True if the volume is a virtual clone (V-Clone).
- `ldev_id` (Number) LDEV number of the volume in the family.
- `ldev_id_hex` (String) LDEV number of the volume in the family in hexadecimal format
- `mirror_unit_id` (Number) Mirror Unit (MU) number.
- `parent_ldev_id` (Number) LDEV ID of the immediate parent in the cascade.
- `pool_id` (Number) Pool ID associated with the snapshot.
- `primary_or_secondary` (String) Indicates if the volume is a P-VOL or S-VOL.
- `pvol_ldev_id` (Number) LDEV number of the Primary Volume.
- `pvol_ldev_id_hex` (String) P-VOL LDEV ID in hexadecimal format
- `snapshot_group_id` (String) Internal ID of the snapshot group.
- `snapshot_group_name` (String) Name of the snapshot group.
- `snapshot_id` (String) The unique identifier for the snapshot (usually Pvol,Mu).
- `split_time` (String) The time when the snapshot was split.
- `status` (String) Current status of the snapshot pair.
- `svol_ldev_id` (Number) LDEV number of the Secondary Volume.
- `svol_ldev_id_hex` (String) S-VOL LDEV ID in hexadecimal format
